subject: Early Literacy Screening And ECRI Adoption
overview: The committee reviewed a comprehensive update on early literacy screening pilots and dyslexia intervention strategies. Budget presentations for science and world languages highlighted a shift in high school science sequencing and the loss of external funding for the elementary Italian program.

items.title: Jingle Bell Run Proceeds Distribution
items.summary: Judy Lonergan presented proceeds from the annual Jingle Bell Run to representatives from various schools and clubs across the district.

items.title: Rare Disease Day Recognition
items.summary: The committee recognized Rare Disease Day and heard a presentation regarding galactosemia awareness.

items.title: Humanities Awards and Mock Trial Recognition
items.summary: Dr. Nicole Chiesa recognized students for achievements in writing, Shakespearean performance, and the mock trial competition.

items.title: Project 351 Service Reports
items.summary: Middle school ambassadors presented their experiences participating in the Project 351 launch day and upcoming local service initiatives.

items.title: Routine Approvals and Executive Session
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes from February 3, bills, payroll, and fund transfers.

items.title: Science Department Budget and Curriculum Shift
items.summary: Science Director Rocco Cieri detailed a budget that includes moving Biology from tenth to ninth grade to improve student access to upper-level electives.

items.title: World Language Budget and Italian Funding Shortfall
items.summary: The department reported the loss of $50,000 in Italian government funding for the elementary program and referred the matter to the Curriculum Subcommittee.

items.title: Speech and Language Pathologist Donation
items.summary: Approved a donation from Elizabeth Gomez to fund professional development for speech and language therapists attending a stuttering association conference.

items.title: Middle School Field Trip Approvals
items.summary: Approved eighth-grade trips to New York City and a seventh-grade trip to the W. Alton Jones Environmental Camp.

items.title: Middle School Athletics Update
items.summary: Robert Maloney reported on the successful implementation of the first year of Greater Boston League middle school sports.

items.title: Literacy Screening and Intervention Report
items.summary: Staff provided a comprehensive update on early literacy screening pilots, professional development, and the identification of neurological learning disabilities.

items.title: Substance Abuse Prevention Grant Commitment
items.summary: Approved a letter of commitment for a federal Strategic Prevention Framework grant to support family-based substance misuse programming.

items.title: Fundraising Organizations Financial Report
items.summary: Received an annual report on the financial status and compliance of school-affiliated 501(c)(3) fundraising organizations.

items.title: ECRI Adoption and Curriculum Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Approved the adoption of the Enhanced Core Reading Instruction (ECRI) program for grades K-2 to address foundational literacy weaknesses.
